logline: While secretly administering a charcoal antidote to the poisoned Dowager Duchess in the dead of night, Juliana is stunned when the Duchess suddenly recognizes a distinctive family ring on her hand and fiercely demands the truth about her identity.

moments.description: Juliana prepares to secretly administer medicine to the ailing Dowager Duchess in a dark bedchamber.
The Dowager Duchess recognizes that Juliana is no common servant after she took a whip for her.
moments.key_dialogue: You... you are no common servant. You took Catherine's whip for me the other day.

moments.description: The Dowager Duchess realizes with horror that her own family members are slowly poisoning her.
moments.key_dialogue: Rupert and Catherine want me dead. They are poisoning me in my own bed, aren't they?

moments.description: The Duchess questions Juliana's noble bearing, prompting Juliana to reveal she was cast out by her family.
moments.key_dialogue: Because my family cast me out to rot. I have nothing left in this world but my honor.

moments.description: The Duchess spots a distinctive family signet ring on Juliana's finger, sending her into a state of profound shock.
The Dowager Duchess fiercely grabs Juliana's hand and desperately demands to know where she got the ring.
moments.key_dialogue: Where... where... Where did you get this ring? Speak to me!
